import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Suppress progress bars
lgb.set_log_func(lambda *args: None)
if hasattr(lgb, "set_log_file"):
    lgb.set_log_file(None)

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify feature columns (exclude Id and Cover_Type from train)
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]

X_train = train[feature_cols]
y_train = train["Cover_Type"].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()

# Prepare test predictions array structure
n_classes = 5
y_pred_test = np.full((len(X_test), n_classes), -1)

# For simplicity, we will fit one model and predict directly
# Use stratified split for holdout validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# LightGBM params
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": n_classes,
    "metric": "accuracy",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "verbose": -1,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 30,
    "learning_rate": 0.08,
    "n_estimators": 500,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_by_tree": 0.8,
    "seed": 42,
}

print("Training model...")
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Get predictions on validation set for holdout score
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_acc:.6f}")

# Predictions on full test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)
np.savez_compressed("./tmp/predictions.npz", predictions=test_preds)

# Convert to dataframe for submission
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df.loc[:, "Cover_Type"] = test_preds

# Save submission file
submission_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")

# Calculate final metric using validation scores only
final_metric = val_acc
print(f"Final Multi-Class Classification Accuracy on Hold-Out Set: {final_metric:.6f}")
